source.title: Deepseek Just Released The Greatest Claude Code Workflow Ever

normalization.overview: A router-worker design can reduce supervision overhead, but routing alone cannot establish durable authority, evidence or accepted state.
normalization.whyItMatters: Delegated work requires recoverable task contracts, independent acceptance, and continuity after the initiating conversation ends.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Compare conventional sessions, router-worker orchestration, and durable task contracts using accepted results, cost, interruption recovery and authority boundaries.
normalization.falsification: Reject the architectural advantage if matched trials do not improve accepted correct work and interruption recovery after total resource, review and failure costs are counted.
normalization.freshness: Video claims are source-attributed. A separate DeepSeek research prototype establishes context, not independent validation of the Claude Code adaptation.
